_comment: All company names, contacts, and scenario details in this file are illustrative composites — not real customer engagements.

evals.prompt: Generate the data model for the Meridian Financial fraud demo.
evals.expected_output: meridian-financial-data-model.json with build order, meridian-financial-data-model.md, mapping files for fraud-claims and fraud-escalations indices
assertions: data-model.json is valid JSON with build_order array
fraud-claims index defined with keyword fields for claim_id, claim_type, channel, vendor_id
fraud-escalations index defined (written by agent tool)
semantic_text field present if ELSER scene is in scope
build_order places ELSER endpoint before any semantic_text mapping
demo-critical documents enumerated for the Friday 3pm scenario
shard counts are reasonable (1 primary for demo-scale indices)

evals.prompt: Build the complete BuildRight Stores data model from the demo script.
evals.expected_output: buildright-stores-data-model.json with 17-step build order, all 7 indices defined with correct field types, ingest pipeline with scripted_upsert logic, semantic_text on knowledge base
assertions: store-transactions defined as data stream (append-only events)
inventory-positions has discrepancy_pct as computed float field
inventory-positions has store_location as geo_point
associate-knowledge-base has body_semantic as semantic_text
associate-sessions has conversation_history as nested type
build_order places ELSER endpoint before associate-knowledge-base mapping
ingest pipeline includes scripted_upsert logic for inventory-positions
demo-critical documents enumerate specific SKU/store values from script scenarios

evals.prompt: Build the data model for Apex Cloud when the opportunity profile includes a quantified success goal: 'MTTR under 15 minutes'. Assert that the KPI field is added to the incidents index.
evals.expected_output: apex-cloud-data-model.json where the incidents index includes a raw measurement field (e.g. resolution_time_minutes as float) and a derived boolean field (e.g. meets_mttr_target) computed from it. Both fields documented as success_metric_fields in the manifest.
assertions: opportunity-profile.json is read and opportunity_overview.success_goals processed in Step 1b
incidents index (or equivalent MTTR-relevant index) contains a raw measurement field typed as float or long
A derived boolean field (meets_mttr_target or equivalent) is present in the same index
Both fields appear in success_metric_fields array in the data model manifest
D-044 assertion comment added for both new fields (non-null required in seed data)
build_order is not disrupted by the KPI field addition
